use default

smallest_prime_factor(n: int) -> int is
    let i mut = 2

    while i * i <= n do
        if n % i == 0 then
            return i
        fi

        i = i + 1
    od

    n
si

largest_proper_divisor(n: int) -> int =>
    if n == 1 then 1 else n / smallest_prime_factor(n) fi

let divisors =
